description: R55-C05: non-object request roots of workspace.completionMutation.v1, workspace.readModel.v1 and workspace.ownershipPlan.v1 returned 'invalid shared-core input:  must be a JSON object' (empty path). Root rows pin the named message; control rows carry the complete envelope captured before the fix (valid requests, object roots, nested field paths, other operations' root messages). Exception: R55-C07 re-pinned three control rows to its named root message, so other-workspace.intent.v1-root-array, other-timer.completionState.v1-root-array and other-sync.batchPlan.v1-root-array carry the envelope after R55-C07, not the one captured before R55-C05.
